---
title: "Handoff, Resolve and Report"
description: "Deliver a portable saved result that can be read and presented without repeating the solve."
sidebar: simulation
---

The final product is a portable run/result package plus a readable Report,
not only a live solver session. OrPen must be able to move the package, open a
fresh analysis process and inspect the same attributed result.

## Backend workflows

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Palace

| Stage | Required delivery |
| --- | --- |
| Prepare | Source/stack/settings identity, final mesh/config, launch/runtime requirements and a distinct not-run handoff. |
| Execute | Explicit native operation, actual exit/recorder evidence, warnings and output cohort; no automatic retry. |
| Return | Completed or partial/failed status from the real operation, with fields, matrices/modes and refinement history actually produced. |
| Resolve | Fresh-process strict completed-result resolution using the retained preparation identity; separate inspection of incomplete packages without inventing completion. |
| Report | Readable physics output, native warnings, adaptation, mesh selection and separate cost/performance information. |

### AEDT

| Stage | Required delivery |
| --- | --- |
| Prepare | Source/body/section request and model/setup/port settings, runtime/resource requirements and a distinct not-run handoff. |
| Execute | Owned project/design/session; native build/assignment/setup readback, solve/export, save and release without affecting another Desktop. |
| Return | Saved project and required results/dependencies, raw exports, native completion and actual convergence evidence. |
| Resolve | Fresh-process reading of the sealed returned cohort; no live-object dependence, hidden Analyze or regenerated model. |
| Report | Correct family/port/matrix/mode labels, units, missingness, setup and history; offline HTML usable for desktop/mobile reading. |

:::

The package must preserve input/output identity, relative paths and model
dependencies after relocation. A preparation receipt is not a solve receipt.

OrPen supplies the exact source/stack and chosen case settings, together with
the preparation identity retained independently of the return. The handoff
must carry these inputs into the real operation; the returned cohort must
retain enough identity to read the same quantity after moving the package.

## Saved fields and offline loss

For AEDT EPR, saved-field evaluation may open the retained native solution to
acquire requested integrals, but must not run Analyze again. Keep that operation
separate from file-only reanalysis of already acquired typed participation.
Offline loss readout changes only explicitly supplied assumptions.

For Palace, retain the native energies/participation/fields needed for the
same requested interpretation. A missing output is shown as unavailable,
not synthesized from a prior pass or a different family.

## Final product to inspect

One coherent result package and Report showing physics outputs, actual run
status/warnings and numerical history, with separate performance information.
Do not replace the result with screenshots, cached objects or an implementation
checklist. Publication of private run data is not part of this requirement.

::: {.callout-note title="Continue in the same backend notebook"}

Follow the Prepare, Handoff, returned-run Resolve and Report stages in
[SimplePad Palace Electrostatic](../../notebooks/ComponentSimulation/SimplePad/palace_electrostatic.ipynb),
[CircularPad Palace Eigenmode](../../notebooks/ComponentSimulation/CircularPad/palace_eigenmode.ipynb),
[SimplePad Q3D](../../notebooks/ComponentSimulation/SimplePad/aedt_q3d.ipynb)
or [SimplePad HFSS EPR](../../notebooks/ComponentSimulation/SimplePad/aedt_hfss_eigenmode.ipynb),
according to the requested quantity. Open returned-run analysis in a fresh
process; Resolve and Report are reading stages, not instructions for another
solve. Keep saved-field evaluation and file-only loss reanalysis separate.

:::

[eigenmode](../requirements/eigenmode.qmd), [EPR](../requirements/epr-loss.qmd),
[Terminal](../requirements/driven-terminal.qmd), [Modal](../requirements/driven-modal.qmd),
[Q3D](../requirements/q3d-acrl.qmd) and [Q2D](../requirements/q2d-cross-section.qmd).
